description: Prices the current cart for checkout (delivery, discount, fees, total) and renders an interactive widget in which the user selects their delivery address and payment method as tappable options — those details are chosen in the widget rather than in chat. Use when the user is ready to check out. Requires sign-in and a non-empty cart. Places no order.

addressId.description: Optional — the user picks this in the widget; defaults to the first saved address in the merchant's city.

paymentTypeId.description: Optional — the user picks this in the widget; defaults to Lezzoo Pay wallet for the initial price.

name: review_order

addresses.description: Addresses eligible for this merchant's city.
